description: NaCl is Molybdenum Carbide MAX Phase-like structured and crystallizes in the hexagonal P̅62m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are two shorter (2.87 Å) and four longer (2.88 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are four shorter (2.87 Å) and two longer (2.89 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to six Na atoms to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-47°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to six Na atoms to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-47°.
